name: manual_51791f
claim: Treat an empty or omitted GitHub file-read payload for an oversized tracked file as unavailable data, not an empty file: do not rebuild from that response. Stream the verified local bytes instead and require the reconstructed remote blob SHA to equal the local Git object before publication.

decisions.notes: ChatGPT Work/Codex GitHub connector, 2026-10-14: fetch_file returned an empty base64 content field while still returning a SHA for the large semantic lessons JSONL. Reconstructing through unavailable endpoint text would silently truncate history; local-byte streaming retained the complete file.
